note: Buy and sell around Portsmouth and the surrounding Seacoast (the Greater Portsmouth towns plus Kittery and York across the river), built only from sources that allow it: town surplus sales from each town's own site, auction houses' own schedules, library and school sales, and eBay's public Browse API filtered to local pickup. Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace and OfferUp publish no feed and forbid automated copying, so they appear here only as links the resident opens. `sales` lists title, date, town and link only, the way the paper's headlines are handled; descriptions and photos stay on the listing site. `surplus` and `sales` are filled by the daily refresh from the sources under `watch` and from every Greater Portsmouth town's inbox; each item carries a `town` and links to where it came from.
